body:
My friend and I are both in the Marine Corps.  We used to use DXM recreationally via Robitussin Maximum Strength Cough.  My friend consumed 3 bottles (1062 mg of DXM) of Robitussin on a Saturday night, and was tested for drugs the following Monday.  He passed.  No PCP or Opiates were found in his sample only two days after a high dosage of DXM.
